Description: Lynchburg is a Blue Ridge foothills independent city with a local VA clinic, Liberty University and University of Lynchburg, a James River outdoor setting, and a sizable nuclear technology and defense manufacturing base anchored by BWXT and Framatome. It offers below-average living costs and moderate home values, with tradeoffs including humid summers, a center-right local voting profile, and crime near the national violent-crime baseline.
